cost_estimate_disclaimer.basis: per-token pricing from GitHub's published usage-based rates; 1 AI credit = $0.01. No model is free under usage-based billing (incl. gpt-5-mini).
cost_estimate_disclaimer.calibration: measured against GitHub Billing on 2 runs: 14.5/16 (91%) and 25.3/27 (94%) — tends to run slightly UNDER actual
known_divergences: cache-write tokens are counted but NOT priced — pricing them was measured to overshoot actual billing badly (136%)
token classes the SDK may report differently from how GitHub bills
published rates may have changed since this config was updated
phases whose model has no configured rate are excluded from totals
cost_estimate_disclaimer.authoritative_source: GitHub Billing — AI-credit balance delta before/after the run (github.com/settings/copilot/features)
